name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (DEAI)
host: Université libre de Bruxelles (ULB) and consortium partners
amount: Erasmus Mundus scholarship (the standard EM rate is €1,400/month + costs; confirm the amount on the programme page)
dlText: 11 Jan 2027, 12:00 GMT (scholarship track; strict). References due 18 Jan 2027
fields: Data engineering, big data, artificial intelligence
note: Successor to the BDMA programme, for the 2027–2029 cohort. Self-funded/partial-grant track opens 1 Mar 2027 (non-EU deadline 15 May 2027).

name: Copernicus Master in Digital Earth (CDE)
host: Paris Lodron University Salzburg and consortium partners
amount: Erasmus+ EMJM scholarship (€1,400/month) for top-ranked applicants; fee waivers for others
fields: Earth observation, geoinformatics, geospatial data science
note: The Nov–Jan call is open worldwide for EMJM scholarships or self-funded places. European candidates have a separate non-scholarship window March–May.

name: Imaging and Light in Extended Reality (IMLEX)
host: University of Eastern Finland and consortium partners
amount: Erasmus Mundus scholarship (the standard EM rate is €1,400/month + costs; confirm the amount on the programme page)
dlText: 13 Jan 2027, 23:59 (UTC+2), via Studyinfo
fields: Photonics, computational imaging, computer vision, XR
note: The 2027 round offers full Erasmus Mundus scholarships to all nationalities. Needs a bachelor's in IT, CS, physics, maths, electrical engineering, photonics or a related field.

name: Marshall Scholarships
amount: Covers university fees, living costs and travel (check official page)
dlText: 29 Sep 2026, 17:00 in the endorsing institution's time zone (closed)
note: The 2027 round closed on 29 Sep 2026 (institutions endorsed by 1 Oct). The next round, for 2028 entry, opens in summer 2027.

eligibility.note: The scholarships (incl. Scholarships of Excellence) are for nationals of EU/EEA states and countries associated with the Digital Europe Programme. Non-EU applicants can only get some university-specific waivers.

name: EIT Digital Master School Scholarships
amount: Full or half tuition waivers; Scholarships of Excellence add a monthly living allowance (check official page)
dlText: 31 Jan 2027 (period 1; time not stated). Later periods close 18 Apr and 31 May 2027
fields: Digital technology, AI, cybersecurity, data science, embedded systems, HCI
note: Two-year master's with an innovation and entrepreneurship minor. Period 1 is for non-EU applicants who need a residence permit, but the main scholarships are mostly for EU/EEA nationals.

eligibility.note: Excellent graduates from Asian countries. AIT pages list priority countries (Bhutan, Laos, Timor-Leste, Thailand, ASEAN, BIMSTEC and other Asian countries); the lists differ between pages.

name: His Majesty the King's Scholarships (Master's) at AIT
host: Asian Institute of Technology (Royal Thai Government)
amount: Tuition, accommodation and a living bursary for the 22-month master's
dlText: ~late Feb 2027 for August 2027 intake (estimated from earlier cycles)
fields: Engineering, technology and management (School of Engineering and Technology, School of Management)
note: A related HM the Queen's scholarship covers environment-related programmes. Apply through AIT admissions. Deadlines on AIT pages differ, so check the current page.

eligibility.note: Nationals of IsDB Least Developed Member Countries (see the call). Age limit 30 at the closing date.

name: IsDB Master of Science Scholarship Program for Least Developed Member Countries
dlText: ~end Feb 2027 for 2027–28 (estimated; IsDB says calls open in Dec and close end of Feb)
note: Two-year M.Sc. scholarship. The 2026–27 call is open now; the 2027–28 call is expected in December 2026.

eligibility.note: Citizens of AfDB regional member countries (African countries), aged 35 or under.

name: Japan Africa Dream Scholarship (JADS) Program
host: African Development Bank & Government of Japan
dlText: Set by each partner university in Japan (no AfDB application)
fields: Development-related fields such as energy, agriculture, health, engineering
note: Formerly the Japan-AfDB Scholarship Program (JSP). Apply to a listed Japanese partner university; check the official eligibility page for work-experience rules.

eligibility.note: International (non-German) students planning a four-semester master's at a German university; who can apply from abroad depends on the KAS country office.

name: Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung Scholarships for International Students
amount: Up to €992/month for a master's (standard two-year period)
dlText: 15 Jul 2027, 12:00 noon (if already in Germany); KAS offices abroad set their own dates
tags: Apply via KAS office abroad or in Germany
note: Two routes: apply in Germany (15 July) or through a KAS country office, with deadlines such as 30 Jun or 30 Nov. Funded by the Federal Foreign Office.

eligibility.note: Students from Africa, Asia, Latin America and Eastern Europe already enrolled at a German university; Western Europeans not supported. About 40 places a year.

name: Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung Scholarships for International Students
dlText: 30 Nov 2026 (master's; time not stated). Next master's deadline 31 May 2027
tags: Must already be enrolled in Germany
note: You cannot apply from abroad; you must be enrolled at a German university first. Master's deadlines are 30 Nov and 31 May.

eligibility.note: Foreign nationals coming to or studying in Germany with a completed bachelor's, excellent results and German at B2.

name: Rosa-Luxemburg-Stiftung Study Scholarship (international students)
dlText: ~1 Oct 2027 for funding from 1 Apr 2028 (estimated from 2025/2026 cycles)
note: Funded by the Federal Foreign Office. The yearly 1 October deadline is for grants starting the next summer semester; the 2026 round has closed.

eligibility.note: International students with German at B2 or higher. Many HSS country offices pre-select locally (some year-round, India: 30 Nov / 31 May).

name: Hanns-Seidel-Stiftung Scholarships for International Students
dlText: 15 Jan 2027 (window opens 15 Dec 2026; time not stated). Country offices may differ
note: Two windows a year on the main portal (15 Dec–15 Jan and 15 Jun–15 Jul). If your country has no HSS office, apply to the nearest one.

eligibility.note: Graduates from developing/emerging countries in Africa, Asia, the Middle East and Latin America, normally via KAAD partner committees. Mainly Catholic/Christian applicants; German skills required.

nominationBody: KAAD partner committee in your country
name: KAAD Scholarship Programme 1 (graduate scholarships)
dlText: No single date; apply through KAAD partner committees in your country
note: Two steps: online questionnaire, then full documents. KAAD also offers in-country master's scholarships in some partner countries and Programme 2 for students already in Germany.

eligibility.note: International students whose first degree is from abroad and who want a master's in Germany; priority for DAC-country applicants not yet living in Germany.

name: Heinrich Böll Foundation Scholarships for International Students
dlText: 1 Mar 2027 (portal opens 15 Jan 2027; time not stated). Next: 1 Sep 2027
note: One Böll page says that from 1 Mar 2027 only first-cycle programmes will be accepted, so check whether master's applications are still taken. Online applications only.

name: Europhotonics – Erasmus Mundus Master in Photonics
amount: €1,400/month EMJM scholarship for up to 24 months
dlText: 4 Feb 2027, 17:00 Paris time
note: 2027–2029 intake. Applying online automatically considers you for an EMJM scholarship.

name: Mundus MAPP – Erasmus Mundus Master's in Public Policy
host: Central European University (CEU) and consortium partners
dlText: 1 Dec 2026 for financial aid (time not stated)
note: 2027–2029 cohort. No separate scholarship form; tick financial aid in the CEU application. Self-funded deadlines 15 Apr (non-EU) and 1 Jul 2027 (EU/EEA).

name: European Master in Law and Economics (EMLE)
dlText: 31 Dec 2026 (non-European applicants); 15 Jan 2027 (European); time not stated
note: Applications for 2027/2028 opened 1 Sep 2026. Also targeted places for Sub-Saharan Africa and the Western Balkans, and an outreach fee waiver.

name: Joint International Master in Semiconductor ChipS Integration and Innovation (SSI²)
host: University of South-Eastern Norway (USN) and consortium partners
dlText: 10 Jan 2027 (EM scholarship and non-EU applicants; time not stated)
note: Successor to the SSIs master. Scholarships depend on the EU grant agreement, expected mid-Nov 2026. EU/EEA self-funded deadline 15 Apr.

name: MESPOM – Erasmus Mundus Master in Environmental Sciences, Policy and Management
host: Central European University (CEU) and consortium partners
dlText: 7 Jan 2027, 23:59 CET (scholarship applicants)
note: 2027–2029 intake. Self-funded deadlines 15 Apr 2027 (visa needed) and 15 Jul 2027 (visa-free).

name: Choreomundus – International Master in Dance Knowledge, Practice and Heritage
amount: €1,400/month for 24 months (15 places in 2026; 2027 numbers not published)
dlText: ~1 Feb 2027, 23:59 EET (estimated from 2026 cycle)
fields: Dance anthropology, ethnochoreology, intangible cultural heritage
note: Applications for 2027/2028 opened 15 Oct 2026. In 2026, 15 students got €1,400/month and 15 more got full fee waivers.
